title: 36-Layer Dual-Stopband with Thickness Continuity Constraint and Quarter-Wave Seeding
scientific_hypothesis: Enforcing adjacent layer thickness difference constraints (Δd ≤ 12 nm) during population initialization, combined with quarter-wave optical thickness seeding at 360 nm and 1050 nm, will reduce impedance discontinuities that caused score regression in rounds 2-3, enabling the optimizer to recover or exceed the round-1 baseline score of 0.9405.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack initialization provides physically sensible starting points for dual-stopband rejection; thickness continuity constraints prevent steep gradients that destabilize optimization; 36 layers provide sufficient degrees of freedom for dual-band suppression while maintaining passband transmission.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
manufacturing_considerations: adjacent layer thickness difference Δd ≤ 12 nm during initialization
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
Impedance matching through gradual thickness transitions
expected_advantages: Reduced optimization instability from steep thickness gradients
Physically meaningful initialization reduces search space
known_risks: Thickness continuity constraint may limit optimizer exploration
36 layers may still exhibit local minima
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees unpolarized illumination. Initialize thicknesses using quarter-wave optical thickness at 360 nm for UV stopband and 1050 nm for NIR stopband, with adjacent layer thickness difference constrained to ≤12 nm during population initialization. Thickness bounds: 20-350 nm per layer. Optimize to maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm passband while minimizing average transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm stopbands and minimizing transmittance at 355 nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with continuity-constrained initialization. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Incorporates feedback directive to enforce Δd ≤ 12 nm constraint during initialization and quarter-wave seeding at 360/1050 nm to address impedance gradient issues from prior rounds
